Comment: This is the net flux between land and atmosphere defined as photosynthesis MINUS the sum of plant and soil respiration, carbonfluxes from fire, land use fluxes, and any other C flux in/out of the ecosystem (eg DIC, DOC, VOCs,...). Positive flux is into the land. NBP SHOULD be equal to changes in total carbon reservoirs. Previously reported in units, kg C C m-2 s-1. Please remove the letter C in output files.
CMIP7 Description: Carbon Mass Flux out of Atmosphere Due to Net Biospheric Production on Land [kgC m-2 s-1]
